# Foxie Media

> Foxie Media is a personal branding and brand management studio founded by Varsha Sangolli. It helps ambitious brands and founders build visibility, credibility and growth through strategy, storytelling and content.

Foxie Media is not a traditional social media marketing agency. Strategy comes first. Design, editing and AI creative are built into the work.

- Website: https://foxie.media/
- Founder: Varsha Sangolli
- Email: varsha@foxie.media
- Phone: +91 73381 78311
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hey.varshh/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/varsha-sangolli-177542349

## Services

### Personal branding
Positioning, content strategy, scriptwriting, creative direction, editing and growth reviews for founders and personal brands.

### Brand management
End-to-end brand content: strategy, calendars, copywriting, design, reels, video editing and social media management.

## Selected work

- Toolandtea (personal branding): 0 to 10K Instagram followers in 30 days
- Swishy AI (brand management): 0 to 15K Instagram followers in 30 days
- Mugdha Bhagchandka (personal branding): 5K to 10K Instagram followers in 30 days
- LifeAt (brand management)
- Sindhu Biswal (personal branding)
- Naiyya Saggi (personal branding)
- Mihika (personal branding)

Brand work also includes Smash Guys, The Pizza Bakery, Diabesmart, Paris Panini, Neuro and Protein Chef.
